name: latrobe.edu.au
comment: Notice with only an 'Allow Cookies' button, so it is hidden. The site's CSS keyed on body.gdpr-on and #gdpr siblings would otherwise offset the sticky header and the search button.

optOut.stylesheet: body.gdpr-on #header { top: 0 !important; } body.vi #header #gdpr ~ #global-search-button, body.vi #header #gdpr ~ #global-search-button + label { top: 1.25rem; bottom: auto; }
